prerequisites.rationale_text: Creating and maintaining psychological safety requires awareness and management of the emotional dynamics in a team. The PS article repeatedly discusses managing the conflict between the logical brain and the emotional brain — that management IS emotional intelligence.
prerequisites.source_quote: Every person has two parts of the brain fighting for control — the upper-level logical part and the lower-level emotional part. The logical part can easily understand that knowing one's weaknesses is beneficial, but the emotional part typically hates it.

curation_notes.summary: Implicit but strong. Leaders who lack emotional intelligence cannot create or sustain psychological safety — they'll either fail to read when people feel unsafe or react emotionally to dissent, destroying the very environment they're trying to build.
